claim: Patchline ships a multi-site randomized controlled trial across independent organizations with pooled analysis. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the randomized controlled trial claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make multi-site-rct-gate`.
